text:
We are a new party in class, here for the whole society which we call: “The Loving Class”


My Corona project has been to start a party, The Synthetic Party, because some in society I see suffer, and what I can contribute is to bring forward my own story. 


I see myself working with something called The Synthetic Party, and being an advocate for it either through industry or by supporting it politically, for it is not just climate-friendly and a possible economy, but an important step for us as a society to become a “type 2” civilization.  


I apologize for having been in a dark place but I will try to be in the “Service of Love” in society. 


I know one must behave properly and there are consequences of what one does but if we as humans do not stop police violence and police brutality, wherever it occurs, then we are no better than cavemen where the strongest rule and the smartest lose their limbs. 


I will use my political engagement and upcoming party, The Synthetic Party, to work towards and for a world where everyone has complete and equal rights they deserve, namely freedom, love, and the right to live life as they themselves want.


The Synthetic Party will create a society with happy citizens who can serve as a model for other countries.


Everyone has the right to dream.


The starting point for The Synthetic Party is my own experiences in my life, but also what I have heard from/seen in all those I have met in my life.


In fact, throughout my life I have been curious about things I did not understand.


The Synthetic Party wants to create the perfect imperfect society.
